statement: A durable seed can no longer serve bootstrap purely on a persisted seed role: before serving, it must confirm a cluster-id match plus either durable quorum evidence or contact with a current cluster member, so an isolated stale seed cannot resurrect a divergent cluster. doneWhen: the test-receipt probe reads solve/evidence/seed-restart-recovery-mode-v2.receipt.json with outstanding 0 — seed-serving recovery-gate receipts passing (deterministic red-on-revert evidence harness).

constraints.statement: If this Quest changes source code, spawn a subagent verifier before audit and git handoff, then record a Solver finding with evidence subagent:<id>.
The cluster-id match this gate requires is minted by durable-cluster-identity; this Quest must not be started before that Quest's join-gate frontier lands.

Keep the isolated-stale-seed fault test the audit proposed: a durable seed with no reachable current member and no durable quorum evidence must refuse to serve bootstrap, and the test must fail when the gate is removed.

A persisted seed role alone must remain insufficient (the behavior asserted as intended in test/bootstrap/rejoin-hints.test.js:331-391 changes); peer proof is REQUIRED unless the recovery evidence is satisfied.
Each new regression test must fail when the recovery gate is reverted while the rest of the change remains.
